thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: high p50/p99 latency on /v1/responses-stream (us-west-2). Spike started ~2052345600 - automatic escalation to #incidents.

sam (oncall): seeing it, grabbing the handoff. what are the numbers?

maria (sre): p50 up from 60ms -> 600ms, p99 ~4.2s, concurrency queue growth on push-backend (kq length). link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/push-latency?orgId=1

kevin (runtime): kernel-level scheduling looks fine, but GPU workers are overloaded with long-running streaming sessions. KV cache miss ratio is up ~3x.

sam (oncall): customers impacted? public API or dedicated?

devon (product): initial reports from a few PLG apps using streaming chat. non-streaming fallback still works but slower for those apps. raising to CAPP > maybe degrade experience.

maria (sre): traffic shape: >90% of streaming sessions are short (<10 tokens) but staying open, causing persistent concurrency. looks like a client-side retry loop from a mobile SDK release hitting streaming fallback.

kevin (runtime): short-term mitigation options: 1) global streaming toggle to off for hosted API in usw2 2) per-customer streaming opt-out 3) apply rate-limit on new streaming sessions (token bucket). fastest is flip the feature flag at edge.

sam (oncall): I recommend temporarily disabling streaming in us-west-2 and shift traffic to non-streaming responses while we throttle and work root cause. Can someone execute?

maria (sre): agreed. prepare rollback plan. impact: all streaming SSE/chunked responses will return final non-streaming responses; some integrations may rely on chunked events (websocket clients). inform support.

kevin (runtime): ready to flip. command to admin API:

```# admin toggle
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.private.redwood/api/v1/feature-flags" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"flag":"streaming_usw2_enabled","value":false}'
```

kevin (runtime): also pushing a panic config to router: set header X-Allow-Stream:false for region filter. will patch in 30s.

ops-bot: Executing playbook: notify-support -> update-status -> flip-flag.

sam (oncall): go for it. kevin, call out ETA and rollback steps.

kevin (runtime): flipping now. ETA 20s to propagate to edge caches, 2m for full convergence. rollback: set value=true, clear edge cache via /admin/edge/flush?region=usw2.

ops-bot: Feature flag change accepted (id=ff_7921).

maria (sre): putting brief on-call checklist in thread: 1) monitor p50/p99 2) watch worker queue length 3) check error rates for non-streaming path (status 500/502) 4) tell support to update customers 5) don't restart workers unless asked.

sam (oncall): support notified. message template: "We're temporarily disabling streaming in us-west-2 to stabilize latency; you will still get final responses but not chunked streaming—apologies." devon please post in status page if we keep this >30m.

devon (product): noted. will draft status: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/streams-2052345678 (draft).

maria (sre): after flip, p50 -> 85ms within 90s, p99 -> 700ms within 3m. queue length dropping.

kevin (runtime): confirming: SST connections still accepted but server responds with final payload and Connection: close. fallback path exercised.

sam (oncall): good. any errors introduced by non-streaming path?

maria (sre): small increase in CPU on aggregator service but error rate stable. watch token consumption per request (might rise cause clients now wait longer).

kevin (runtime): applying short-term rate-limit to new /v1/responses requests to prevent retry storms: 120 rpm per key for 10m.

ops-bot: Applied rate-limit policy rl_334 for region=usw2.

devon (product): customer impact: 14 customers flagged with streaming active in us-west-2; currently reached out to top 5 with account manager ping.

sam (oncall): handoff: I'm on for next 25 minutes while we monitor. if p99 < 900ms and queue < 50 for 10m, we'll consider re-enabling with a gradual canary. otherwise escalate to eng-runtime.

kevin (runtime): logging canary plan: enable on canary pool (20 servers) with streaming_enabled=true for canary customers only, observe for 15m. command:

```# canary flag
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.private.redwood/api/v1/feature-flags" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"flag":"streaming_usw2_canary","value":true, "meta":{"pool":"canary"}}'
```

maria (sre): create Grafana panel for canary vs control immediately. tagging metrics with canary=true.

ops-bot: Pager handoff reminder: @devon, please follow up with product comms. @sam, alert if metrics regress.

devon (product): posting status update now. will include note about expected behavior and workaround (use non-stream endpoint, SDK update coming).

sam (oncall): summary for postmortem starter: root cause suspected client-side retry pattern holding streaming sessions open, amplifying worker concurrency; mitigation: streaming toggle off in us-west-2 + rate-limits + canary re-enable; next steps: root-cause with SDK team, telemetry to detect long-idle streaming sessions, improve idle timeouts.

kevin (runtime): saving logs and timestamps: saved snapshot -> s3://incidents/2052345678/snapshot.log

maria (sre): taking ownership of the postmortem doc. I'll collect traces, Grafana panels, and customer list.

sam (oncall): closing active intervention: streaming disabled regionally and rate-limits applied. i'll update thread with final re-enable time or further actions. thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident action recorded: mitigation_applied, severity=moderate, ticket=INC-2052345678
